profile_text.body:
Course Hero, founded in 2006 and based in Redwood City, describes itself as a platform offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep materials, and 24/7 homework help alongside tutoring services. The company positions its offering around what it calls "owning the study hour" and helping students get unstuck with learning materials and academic support.

Course Hero operates QuillBot, a paraphrasing and writing tool categorized as a writing and editing product. The company is a business of Learneo, Inc.
